title: Regional Sales Manager - West India
jobDescription:
He is responsible for achieving assigned sales targets through Government sales channels. This includes identifying and developing strategic opportunities within key government customers, acquiring new accounts, and driving growth within existing accounts Primary Accountabilities: · MUST
- Drive Government Sales by leveraging strong relationships and established networks within government and public-sector accounts (State Govt.- Maharashtra and Gujrat) . . Goal is to increase number of large customers and move to maximize opportunities in total account for all products and services that Radware offers. · Responsible for business development in assigned region and maintain pipeline as per assigned sales target. · Responsible for preparing and coordinating account management plans of sales proposals, tenders/bid teams and contracts. . Team handling experience . Responsible for profit / loss accountability for region · Required to maintain account plans and participate in regular “test and improve” sessions on current opportunities. Engineering graduate. Engineering with an MBA will be preferred Proven sales skills with end customers, preferably with channel interaction as a benefit, with at least 8-10 years proven experience. Excellent product knowledge and ability to apply features and benefits of products to user needs as well as proven history in learning new product sets and features and applying these to customer sales opportunities. Solution selling skill and knowledge/ understanding of Enterprise Application and technology Ability to keep customers abreast of technological developments and trends and competitive activity and communicate relevant information to customer base. Ability to work with Channel and manage end user sales . Understanding of channel, distribution and IT market landscape. Understanding of Application delivery & security solution as well as other complimentary products and partners. Good track record in the industry Strong proven negotiation skills to sell value of product and not focus on pricing. Open for travel across the region

title: Technical Manager - West India
jobDescription: The Technical Manager must be able to articulate technology and product positioning to both business and technical users. Technical Managers are the primary technical resource for the sales force. Technical Manager are responsible for actively driving and managing the technology evaluation stage of the sales process, working in conjunction with the sales team as the key technical advisor and product advocate for our products. Technical Manager should work very closely with System Integrators & partners in our target market segments. TM must be able to identify all technical issues of assigned SI/ Partner to assure SI/ partner satisfaction through all stages of the association . Must be able to establish and maintain strong relationships with customers and partners throughout the sales cycle. Requirement: • 10–15 years of pre-sales and post-sales technical experience in the networking field. • Proven field pre-sales experience within India and enterprise customers. • Skilled in competitive product analysis and positioning solutions based on customer requirements. • Capable of technically closing complex and competitive opportunities through advanced product knowledge, technical expertise, and credibility. • Identify revenue-impacting support escalations and proactively engage with relevant internal and external stakeholders to ensure timely and satisfactory resolution. • Actively collaborate and communicate with Product Management, Business Units, Sales, and Marketing teams. • Broad understanding of the security threat landscape and the IT security industry—past, present, and future. • Serve as a trusted advisor in key accounts, ensuring effective coordination between sales, support, and R&D to deliver high customer satisfaction. • Strong knowledge of cloud solution offerings, particularly Saa S. • Excellent presentation and communication skills. Demonstrates leadership initiative and a willingness to learn new technologies. • Ability to develop solutions by translating customer business requirements into integrated technical solutions. • Monitor and support partners during large project implementations, providing guidance and management throughout the project lifecycle. Engineering graduate. Engineering with an MBA will be preferred Proven sales skills with end customers, preferably with channel interaction as a benefit, with at least 8-10 years proven experience. Excellent product knowledge and ability to apply features and benefits of products to user needs as well as proven history in learning new product sets and features and applying these to customer sales opportunities. Solution selling skill and knowledge/ understanding of Enterprise Application and technology Ability to keep customers abreast of technological developments and trends and competitive activity and communicate relevant information to customer base. Ability to work with Channel and manage end user sales . Understanding of channel, distribution and IT market landscape. Understanding of Application delivery & security solution as well as other complimentary products and partners. Good track record in the industry Strong proven negotiation skills to sell value of product and not focus on pricing. Open for travel across the region

title: CSC Support Enginner
jobDescription: %3Cp class=%22Default%22 style=%22line-height:150%;text-align:center;%22%3EJob Description Cloud Service Center Engineer:%26nbsp;%3C/p%3E%3Cp class=%22Default%22 style=%22line-height:150%;%22%3ERadware is a global leader of cyber security and application delivery solutions for physical, cloud, and software defined data centers.%26nbsp;%3Cbr%3E%3Cbr%3EAt Radware, we live and breathe cybersecurity. It is our passion. Each day, our international team works to earn the trust of more than 12,500 organizations around the globe. Keeping them safe is our mission. To that end, we go head-to-head with politically motivated hacktivists, dangerous nation-state threat actors and other notorious cyber attackers — these are not your average adversaries. Backed by nearly 30 years of experience, Radware is best known for its technical excellence and innovative network and application security solutions. That is why it is so important that we build our team with bold and bright talent.%26nbsp;%3Cbr%3E%3Cbr%3E%3Cstrong%3EAbout the Team%3C/strong%3E: Radware Cloud Service Center Team provides immediate and direct support for our cloud customers, and acts as the first line of response for all Radware’s cloud customers ensuring the continued functioning of protected services and, ultimately, customer satisfaction.%26nbsp;%3Cbr%3E%3Cstrong%3EWhat is the job: The Cloud Service Center Engineer (SCE)%3C/strong%3E fuels the success of customers by serving as the primary contact for Radware related issues, you will be the first line of response for our customers, ensuring the smooth operation of their cloud services. Your primary responsibilities will include monitoring Radware cloud customer services, performing basic troubleshooting, and providing timely support to resolve issues. If you are an energetic, upstart engineer who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and interacting with people under pressure, this could be the position for you.%26nbsp;%3Cbr%3E%3Cbr%3E%3Cstrong%3EWhat you need:%26nbsp;%3C/strong%3E%3Cbr%3E• At least 1 year experience in application security or Master%27s degree in Cyber Security%26nbsp;%3Cbr%3E• Good understanding of network design (e.g. LAN/WAN, switches/routers, routing protocols such as BGP and OSPF) and protocols (e.g., IPv4, TCP/IP, VPN, IPSec, HTTP, DNS)%26nbsp;%3Cbr%3E• Good understanding of and experience with Layers 3,4, and 7 network %26amp; security fundamentals • Wireshark, Kali Linux%26nbsp;%3Cbr%3E• Familiarity with OWASP Top 10 web application security%26nbsp;%3Cbr%3E• Experience in a customer facing/support role%26nbsp;%3Cbr%3E• Excellent troubleshooting and diagnosis capabilities%26nbsp;%3Cbr%3E• Knowledge and troubleshooting experience in network communications – Routing – BGP , TCP, packet analyzing.%26nbsp;%3Cbr%3E• Willing to be on alert during off-work hours including weekends%26nbsp;%3Cbr%3E• Excellent communication skills and team work%26nbsp;%3Cbr%3E• Excellent time management, multi-tasking, and prioritization skills%26nbsp;%3Cbr%3E• Ability to collaborate, sync and manage processes with other teams to achieve incident resolution%26nbsp;%3Cbr%3E• Create and follow runbooks to assure system health and KPI%26nbsp;%3Cbr%3E• Perceptive, fast learner, and able to perform well under pressure%3C/p%3E How can you stand out: • Experience in similar positions/companies • BSc/BA in Computer Science or equivalent • Graduated Networking or Security courses • Experience with monitoring tools, routers, switches, load balancers, and firewalls • Knowledge of scripting, automation methods and orchestration technologies Experience working with CSPs such as AWS, GCP and Azure. • Foreign language (other than Hebrew and English) Why you should join us: Employees from more than 40 countries have chosen Radware as a place where they can belong. Radware has been recognized by Glassdoor and BDI as one of the World’s Best Places to Work, ranking among the top 100 companies across the globe in the IT category. Radware has also been named a Gold Winner for Application Security in the 2023 Global Cybersecurity Awards, by Forrester a Leader in DDo S Protection, and has been named a Leader in WAF Market by Quadrant Knowledge Solutions. We are equally committed to our people. We strive to create a dynamic work environment that celebrates diversity, promotes equality, and thrives on the unique contributions of each individual. If you are ready to be part of a global-minded company that is inspired to create a better, safer future; and if and want to fight for the good guys and be at the forefront of helping companies protect their most critical assets from today’s cyber adversaries, then you’ve found the right fit at Radware.

title: Technical Support Engineer – Tier2
jobDescription: TAC Engineer-Tier 2 Radware has changed how businesses are securing the digital experience. As a result, it’s now the recognized industry leader and undergoing explosive growth in the rapidly expanding security market. A leading provider of cyber security and application delivery solutions, Radware (RDWR) is looking for a Tier 2 Technical Support Engineer to fuel the success of customers by providing effective technical support to customers and partners alike to ensure the success of the organization. If you’re an energetic, upstart engineer who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and interacting with people, this could be the position for you. As a Tier 2 Technical Support Engineer, you will support Radware products including: ADC (Application Delivery Controllers) Web Application Firewall (WAF), IPS (Intrusion Prevention System) Products. In addition to possessing deep technical knowledge, a TAC Engineer interacts extensively with customers and partners using polite professional etiquette. Responsibilities • Providing level two technical support for Radware products. • Use strong TCP/IP networking skills to perform network troubleshooting to isolate and diagnose common network problems. • Take responsibility for customer satisfaction and overall success of the TAC • Respond in a timely manner (within documented SLA) to support Customer issues and Inquiries. • Document actions in tickets to effectively communicate information internally and to customers. • Resolve problems independently and understands the correct escalation procedures. • Reproducing and debugging customer reported problems in a lab environment, as necessary, and working with engineering and test teams to resolve issues; • Documenting issues in a knowledgebase format for use both internal and external to Radware; • Providing timely feedback into the development process on customer-reported product problems. Requirements: • 3-4 years experience with hands on troubleshooting Layer 2 and Layer 3 switching and routing • Expert level knowledge and hands-on experience with L2/L3 Switching/Routing, TCP/IP, IPv4, L4/L7 switching, Firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN, security consulting, SSL, IPSec. • In-depth understanding of protocol and network analyzers. • Bachelor’s degree is required • Excellent customer service skills • Excellent analytical thinking and problem solving skills • Strong verbal (phone) and written (email) communication skills • Self-managed and team oriented • Highly motivated • Proven track record for working with an enterprise and carrier class customer base.

title: Senior Security Analyst
jobDescription:
Description • Real-time detection, analysis, and mitigation of DDo S attacks across customer environments. • Provide real-time support and incident response for customers experiencing web application and security-related attacks. • Perform post-incident Root Cause Analysis and deliver attack reports with findings and recommendations. • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve security-related issues during both attack and non attack (peacetime) periods. • Act as a security consultant for existing and new customers, providing guidance on security best practices, configurations, and mitigation strategies. • Collaborate with internal teams and customers to improve overall security posture and ensure effective protection against evolving threats Qualifications • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. title: Principal Software Engineer
jobDescription: Candidate Profiles- Radware API security We look for "Product Engineers" rather than just "Coders." For a hybrid, cross functional squad in the Cyber/API Security space, the profile needs to emphasize ownership and architectural empathy. Expert Software Engineer (Cyber & API Security) The Role Mission We are looking for a high-autonomy Senior Engineer to join our hybrid squad. You will be a core contributor to our API Security suite, moving seamlessly across the stack from frontend interfaces to complex backend data pipelines. In a distributed team spanning India, Israel, and Europe, you aren't just writing code; you are designing secure, scalable systems and communicating complex ideas across borders. Core Technical Competencies The ideal candidate is a "Generalist Specialist" expert in the backend, but fluent across the entire infrastructure. • Language Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Go and Python (specifically Fast API but not only). • Data & Cloud Infrastructure: o Deep experience with AWS ecosystems o Hands-on experience with Big Data processing using Spark and AWS Glue. Advantage) o Strong grip on Mongo DB. • Dev Ops & Modern Tooling: o Infrastructure as Code Ia C) via Terraform. o Container orchestration with Kubernetes K8s and ECS. o CI/CD using Git Hub Actions. AI Development: Early adopter of AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor to accelerate delivery and maintain code quality. Spec driven design Soft Skills & "The Hybrid Mindset" Since we operate across different time zones, these "human" skills are non negotiable: • Async Communication Pro: You excel at "Push Communication." You don't wait to be asked; you provide proactive updates, documentation, and Loom videos to ensure the team can move forward while you are offline. • Extreme Ownership: You thrive in a "Squad" environment where you own a feature from the Jira ticket to the Terraform deployment. • The "Out of the Box" Hacker: In the Cyber world, you need to think like an attacker. You don't just build APIs; you anticipate how they can be broken. • Rapid Self-Learning: You have a proven track record of picking up new frameworks or technology in days, not weeks. Desired Experience Profile • 8+ years of professional software development experience. • A proven track record of building and maintaining systems that serve thousands of concurrent users or process millions of events per hour. • The ability to identify and resolve bottlenecks across the stack whether itʼs an unoptimized DB query, a slow API response, or a saturated message queue. • Cybersecurity Background: Previous experience in Cyber is a massive plus • Cross-Continental Collaboration: Experience working for a global startup or a product-based company where the headquarters were in a different country. • Full-Stack Fluency: Ability to jump into the frontend React when the squad needs to ship a complete end-to-end feature. • Observability Mindset: You don't just "deploy and pray." You are proficient in using monitoring, logging, and tracing to proactively manage system health before a customer reports an issue. 3 Candidate Profiles- Radware API security
